name: Notion
summary: Self-serve. A public connection works for any workspace the moment you create it. Notion has no per-scope review; users choose which pages to share. Marketplace listing is optional.

composio.note: Composio-managed auth works today. Composio notes that actions then show “Composio” as the actor, not your app, which is a reason to bring your own.

capabilities.label: Read & write shared pages/databases
capabilities.why: No scope review. Access is limited to the pages each user picks

capabilities.label: Read user emails
capabilities.why: A checkbox on the connection's capabilities

capabilities.label: Listed on Notion Marketplace
capabilities.why: Public connections go through a Notion security review before listing

steps.title: Create a public connection
steps.detail: Developer portal → Public connections → Create. Choose an installation scope (Any workspace or Selected workspaces). **You can't change it later**, and only 'Any workspace' can be listed on the Marketplace.
steps.agent: Pre-fill the name, redirect URIs and capabilities
steps.human: Choose the installation scope (permanent) and create it

steps.title: Add organization details
steps.detail: Company name, website, privacy policy, terms of use and support email appear on the consent screen.
steps.agent: Draft a privacy policy and terms page if you don't have them

steps.title: Register exact redirect URIs
steps.detail: If you register more than one URI, the token request must include redirect_uri. Composio BYO: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback
steps.agent: Configure the URIs and test the token exchange

steps.title: Submit the Marketplace listing (optional)
steps.detail: Only 'Any workspace' connections are eligible. Notion runs a security review before listing.

launchToday: Composio-managed Notion auth works for any workspace today.
Your own public connection is live the minute you create it. No review gates usage.
rejections: Marketplace: connection created with 'Selected workspaces only', which can't be listed and can't be changed

blockers.problem: API returns object_not_found for pages the user can see
blockers.fix: Notion only exposes pages the user picked during OAuth. Send them back through the page picker, or have them add the connection to the page.

blockers.problem: Token exchange fails with redirect_uri errors
blockers.fix: With several redirect URIs registered, include redirect_uri in the token request exactly as registered.

uncertain: Notion doesn't publish how long Marketplace review takes.
The required organization fields come from third-party guides; Notion's current docs don't list them.
